audit.whatIsWrong: Three things. (a) tldr says to 'out-sustain him' — this is backwards. Warwick heals from THREE sources in one kit: Eternal Hunger (P) heals on every auto below 50% health and TRIPLES below 25%, Jaws of the Beast (Q) heals for damage dealt on a 6-8s cooldown, and Infinite Duress (R) heals too. Mordekaiser cannot out-sustain that. (b) Jaws of the Beast deals damage based on the target's MAXIMUM HEALTH, so armour and HP stacking are the wrong build — but report[8].t still recommends Plated Steelcaps as the only defensive purchase and nothing warns against stacking. (c) Primal Howl (E) is nowhere on the page: 2.5 seconds of damage reduction followed by a 1-second FEAR, on a 15s cooldown. It both blunts your burst and physically walks you out of your own combo, and the player is never told it exists.
audit.why: Point 4 is the most important point, and the page names only Infinite Duress. Primal Howl is the ability that actually breaks the Mordekaiser trade pattern, and the max-health scaling on Q is the reason the recommended build is wrong.
audit.corrected: Rewrote tldr, winCon, report[0].t and report[5].t around the real interactions: anti-heal early, burst instead of brawl, and armour/HP do not answer max-health damage. Added Primal Howl with its real 15s cooldown, 2.5s damage reduction and 1s fear to breakdown.cooldowns. Added the max-health/anti-heal reasoning to report[8].t. Put the passive's 50%/25% thresholds into dontsFull[0].d and the 1.5s suppress into dontsFull[1].d, both of which previously carried filler unrelated to their own headings.
sources: enemyKit Q text 'damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt', percentHealth flag, cd 8/7.5/7/6.5/6

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named only Infinite Duress and gave no seconds for it.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is 110s at rank 1 — by far the longest window either champion has — and Primal Howl at 15s is the one that decides individual trades. Neither number was on the page.

All three packet.suspectNames hits — 'Blood Hunt's', 'Land Infinite Duress', 'His Infinite Duress' — are FALSE POSITIVES. Blood Hunt and Infinite Duress are the real W and R names; the matcher is flagging possessives and leading verbs. No edits made for any of them.

notes: I did NOT write the first missingInteractions headline ('Your Obliterate (Q) shuts off Warwick's Jaws of the Beast (Q), Infinite Duress (R)'). It is generated from the same grounding:'shuts off enemy dashes' derived flag on Mordekaiser's Q that appears in every matchup in this slice, and Riot's own description of Obliterate says only that it smashes the ground and deals increased damage to a single target — no grounding, no dash denial. Shipping 'hold Q for his engage, it stops his dash' would be a fabricated mechanic on a live page, and it is exactly the advice that gets a player killed as Warwick leaps onto him anyway. Recorded as a question rather than written. The second headline (resistances invalidated by Jaws of the Beast) IS supported by Riot's text and the percentHealth flag, and I did write that one. Separately: Infinite Duress carries a channel:'interruptible — any CC cancels it' flag. Riot's description does not mention a channel, so I left it out of the prose rather than telling players CC on Warwick breaks his suppression; see questionsForUser.
